mapper.select: SELECT id, investigation_id, parent_id, description, status, missing_checks, created_at, updated_at FROM hypothesis WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, investigation_id, parent_id, description, status, missing_checks, created_at, updated_at FROM hypothesis WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hypothesis (investigation_id, parent_id, description, status, missing_checks) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{parentId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{missingChecks})
